general.descripcion: Check verified backups and prepare recovery of the complete system.
general.ayuda_texto: Request a full backup and check its verification. Before recovery, review the destination and the loss of changes. Another person must approve the proposal. The service must verify a backup of the current state before replacing it.
general.vacio: There are no backups yet. Request a full backup when the service is available.
general.seleccionar: Select a backup to view its details.
general.copia_efecto: The service will back up the complete system and run verification. A request does not mean the backup is valid.
general.sin_permiso: Your current permission does not allow this action.
general.fuente_pendiente: This action requires an authorised configuration and an available backup service.
general.sin_cambios: The current configuration remains in place until the server confirms the change.
general.dias_ayuda: If no weekdays are selected, only the configured interval applies.
general.doble_control_ayuda: Recovery always requires another person and a verified backup of the current state, even if you change this retention option.
general.sin_propuestas: There are no pending recovery proposals.
general.propuesta_bloqueada: An authorised destination and window catalogue or the recovery summary is missing. Recovery cannot be prepared.
general.perdidas_texto: Recovery will replace the entire destination state with the selected backup. Changes made since that backup will be lost.
general.segunda_texto: Another administrator must review and approve this same backup and destination.
general.previa_texto: Before replacing the destination, the service must complete and verify a backup of its current state.
general.confirmar_revision: I have reviewed the destination and loss of changes. I confirm that a complete backup of the current state must be created and verified before replacement.
general.ejecutar_bloqueado: Replacement remains blocked until checks are complete and an authorised executor is available.
general.resumen_incompleto: Information needed to review recovery is missing. Refresh or contact IT.
general.error_intervalo: Enter an interval from 1 to 366 days.
general.error_ventana: The end must be after the start on the same date.
general.no_borrado: Protected backups and backups needed for pending operations will not be deleted.
general.copia_no_recuperable: This backup cannot be recovered. It must be valid and compatible with the destination.
general.huella_conjunto: Digest of the backup to recover

errores.denegado: You do not have permission to view or perform this operation. Request the appropriate access.
errores.conflicto: The information has changed. Refresh and review the operation before submitting it again.
errores.solicitud_invalida: The request was not recorded. Check the data and try again.
errores.respuesta_invalida: The service has not confirmed a valid result. Refresh before repeating a request.
errores.no_disponible: The backup service is unavailable. Refresh or contact IT.

compatibilidad.compatible: The complete backup is compatible with the checked destination.
compatibilidad.incompatible: The backup is incompatible with the destination. Prepare a separate procedure.
compatibilidad.no_comprobable: Information needed to check compatibility is missing. This backup cannot be recovered.
compatibilidad.comprobacion_conjunto_compatible: Checking the backup against the destination confirms compatibility.
